integrity_note: The proof is mathematical; finite executable tests independently corroborate finite cases only. scientific_limitations: Single-symbol insertion; linear ordered two-gram counts; asserted nonbinary result for each alphabet size q>=3; no claims for multiple errors, other gram lengths, or optimal coding rates.
title: Exact finite-alphabet insertion-profile shadows and the de Bruijn threshold
